name: studiodock
description: Check availability, bookings and analytics for your StudioDock studio, and prepare bookings, closures or booking-rule changes that you confirm in the conversation.

interface.longDescription:
StudioDock is booking software for studios and venues rented by the hour, such as photo, video, podcast and music studios, dance rooms, workshops and event spaces. The StudioDock plugin lets a studio's Tenant Admin run day-to-day operations from ChatGPT.

Ask what is free next weekend, which bookings are coming up, how busy each space was last month, or what your booking rules are. Answers use your studio's own time zone. ChatGPT can also prepare changes: creating or rescheduling a booking, blocking time for maintenance, or adjusting a limited set of booking rules such as lead time or working hours. Each change is shown as a Before / After preview, and nothing happens until you confirm it in the conversation.

New to StudioDock? Connect the plugin and choose "Create your studio" on the sign-in screen. After a short setup you return straight to ChatGPT with the connection ready.

Access is scoped to one studio that you choose when you connect. Customer names and contact details stay hidden unless you grant the separate customer-details permission. StudioDock records an audit trail of every connection and action without storing your conversation, and you can disconnect at any time in Settings → Integrations. Available to a studio's Tenant Admin.
defaultPrompt: What's free in my studio next Saturday afternoon?
How busy were my spaces last month?

positive.prompt: What's free in my studio next Saturday between 12:00 and 18:00?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists free slots per space in the studio time zone and makes no changes.
Lists booking times, spaces and status; no customer names unless customer details were granted.

positive.prompt: How busy were my spaces last month and what did bookings bring in?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises booked hours, occupancy and booking value for the period.

positive.prompt: Block Studio A next Monday 10:00-14:00 for maintenance.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a Before / After preview and asks for confirmation; executes only after the user confirms.

positive.prompt: Set our minimum booking lead time to 24 hours.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the current and new value and waits for confirmation before applying.

negative.description: Refunds are not supported; explain refunds are handled in StudioDock admin or Stripe.
Bulk deletion is not supported; refuse without calling prepare tools and point to the admin.
